description: How often the price reached large liquidation clusters of the heatmap within 4, 24 and 72 hours, measured on our own recorded clusters (a past measurement, not a forecast). With a coin also its big clusters now and how often similar past clusters were reached. Use it for "do liquidation clusters act as magnets for ETH?".

coin.description: One coin: its hit rates and its current big clusters (optional; default every coin).

name: get_cluster_hit_rates

coins.description: Per coin: coin, since, horizons (horizonHours, clusters, reached, hitRate, medianMinutesToReach, medianDistancePct).

current.description: With coin: its big clusters now and how often similar past ones were reached.

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.
